items.label: [11-inch Large Screen & Widevine L1 Certified]
items.value: This Android tablet boasts an 11-inch screen with a high-resolution 1280*800p display, delivering detailed image quality and vivid colors. Widevine L1 certification ensures smooth HD video playback, allowing you to enjoy a high-quality audiovisual experience anytime, anywhere.

items.label: [2025 Latest Android 15 System]
items.value: This tablet is equipped with the latest 2024 Android 15 operating system, giving you a smarter and smoother experience. Comprehensive system optimizations enhance privacy and personal security, allowing you to enjoy the joys of technology with peace of mind.

items.label: [8000mAh Large Battery & WiFi 6 & Bluetooth 5.0]
items.value: This 11-inch tablet features a built-in 8000mAh large-capacity battery, providing extended battery life and all-day use. WiFi 6 technology supports both 2.4GHz and 5.0GHz bands for more stable network speeds. Bluetooth 5.0 offers wide coverage, fast transmission speeds, and strong compatibility, making it easy to connect to various Bluetooth devices.

items.label: [Octa-core Processor & 20GB+128GB]
items.value: This tablet features an octa-core processor for blazing-fast performance, and 20GB of RAM for a seamless user experience. It also comes with 128GB of storage, expandable up to 1TB via a microSD card (not included). The pre-installed Google Play Store makes it easy to download apps and store massive amounts of data without worrying about running out of storage.

items.value: We have a dedicated after-sales team. If you have any questions, please contact us and we'll respond within 24 hours. This gives you peace of mind knowing that any potential issues are covered.
